mining.label: Mining & handiwork
mining.example: Find an obtainable mining Pal for my current stage, with its acquisition route.
checks: Separate wild, Alpha, breeding and egg routes
Keep listed and four-star work levels separate
Distinguish base work from manual party gathering

mount.label: Ground mounts
mount.example: I am level 52. Compare a replacement for Fenglope by ride sprint speed, stamina and saddle technology.
checks: Compare ride sprint rather than base run speed
Check saddle technology and acquisition separately
Show speed/stamina tradeoffs
mount.query: Palworld {version} {goal} ground mount ride sprint speed stamina saddle

map.label: Locations & dungeons
map.example: Find coal near fast travel and mark five sourced points on a real map.
checks: Use sourced game coordinates
Separate dungeon entrances, camp anchors and interior rewards
Check map calibration and point status
map.query: Palworld {version} {goal} map coordinates fast travel dungeon

loot.label: Loot & farming
loot.example: Compare a camp-to-treasure-map route with a direct schematic farm; verify conditional rates and timing.
checks: Identify the exact item quality and reward table
Weights are not automatically percentages
Separate conditional stage rates from retry independence

base.label: Base & offline care
base.example: On a dedicated server my Pals are hungry and ill the next day. First distinguish empty food boxes from inaccessible food.
checks: Inspect food availability first
Separate continuous operation, pathfinding and offline behavior
Hunger settings do not treat existing illness

mods.label: Mods & multiplayer
mods.example: I subscribed on my PC but cannot see the mod on my dedicated server. Check client/server requirements.
checks: Identify OS, package and installation method
Inspect author requirements, dependencies and Info.json
Distinguish subscription, deployment, loading and gameplay effect
mods.query: Palworld {version} {goal} dedicated server mod Info.json IsServer

items.label: Items & progression
items.example: Explain this weapon or sphere launcher using its exact ammo, unlock and effect fields.
checks: Resolve the exact English item before lookup
Do not assume ammo compatibility or burst count
Separate player stats, Pal stats and party/base limits
items.query: Palworld {version} {goal} weapon ammo technology partner skill

breeding.label: Breeding & owned Pals
breeding.example: Use my Bushi, Penking and Vanwyrm to find a species-level breeding route to Pyrin. Show the parent steps and source version.
checks: Use pinned explicit parent records rather than remembered combinations
Confirm parent sexes and breeding setup separately
Do not equate fewest generations with fewest eggs or shortest real time
